evidence.quote: The Fatcat catalog content license is the Creative Commons Zero ("CC-0") license, which is effectively a public domain grant.

All exports and dumps get uploaded to the Internet Archive under the ["Fatcat Database Snapshots and Bulk Metadata Exports"](https://archive.org/details/fatcat_snapshots_and_exports?&sort=-publicdate) collection.
All mutating API calls (POST, PUT, DELETE HTTP verbs) require token-based authentication using an HTTP Bearer token.
